title: Azerbaijan’s Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
organization: Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan
temporal_coverage: Historical climate trends, current adaptation measures and a regional vulnerability index for 2041–2069; mitigation target year 2035.
methodology: Opened the 96-page NDC; reviewed regional-risk, climate, adaptation and reintegration sections.
limitations: Government synthesis; index method and scenarios unspecified. Its occupation-era damage account is not independently verified.

title: The Great Return
organization: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan
temporal_coverage: Dynamic government page on post-conflict return and reconstruction; includes return to Aghdam beginning in March 2025.
methodology: Opened the government page and reviewed its coordination and Aghdam reconstruction sections.
limitations: Government-reported plans and progress; dynamic page has no single publication date and does not independently evaluate outcomes.

title: UNDP and ANAMA held a Side Event on Mine Action and Environmental Sustainability within COP29
organization: United Nations Development Programme in Azerbaijan
temporal_coverage: Report of a COP29 side event held in Baku on 18 November 2024.
methodology: Opened the full UNDP event report, including statements by ANAMA and UNDP representatives.
limitations: Event statements; the report gives no independent soil sampling or evaluation of demining outcomes.

title: Closing Ceremony Marks Completion of Project on Promoting Kahriz Rehabilitation for Climate Adaptation in Azerbaijan
organization: International Organization for Migration, through United Nations in Azerbaijan
temporal_coverage: Reports kahriz rehabilitation since 2000 and a project completed in March 2026.
methodology: Opened the full IOM project-completion story and reviewed the reported outputs and capacity-development details.
limitations: Reported project outputs are not an impact evaluation; the 20 districts are not identified and household outcomes are not disaggregated.

title: 4th International Mine Action Conference: Humanitarian Demining for Urban Recovery
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator’s Office in Azerbaijan
temporal_coverage: UN Resident Coordinator representative’s speech at a Baku conference on 2 September 2026; includes reported mine-action support during 2020–2025.
methodology: Opened the complete speech and reviewed its return, land-release and national-capacity passages.
limitations: The speech attributes figures to ANAMA and provides no calculation method or independent audit.
